text.text_excerpt: There was a bit of a wait when we went, but much shorter than quoted. Our server was very friendly! (Idk her name but she had red dreds.) I ordered the Bobsled. It's sorrel and Jamaican white rum. And it's awesome! It's exactly what sorrel needed Lol. I ordered the Brownstew chicken with Mac n cheese and festival. Omg!! The brownstew chicken was incredible! That flavor was phenomenal! The mac n cheese and festival were great compliments to it. Perfection! My only complaint is that there really wasn't much chicken in my dish. It was lots of potatoes and only a small amount of chicken. I'm not sure it that was because it was late or if this was their normal portion size. In the bowl it look...

Sweet little spot on Oak St. Excited that they were able to expand outaide of the Pythian Market food hall. I went for Sunday brunch and we got: jerk chicken and waffles, fried green tomatoes, crab cakes, callaloo & plantains, and grits. All that for like $40! Prices are low, which is reflected in the portion size- means you can try more things! The greens in the callaloo dish were the BEST GREENS I HAVE EVER HAD in my life. Everything else was flavorful but I will be thinking about those greens forever. The vibe is slow and laid back- itd be a good place to linger over drinks with friends for a while. (Didnt have any drinks but the cocktail menu looked really good)
